message.reasoning:

That's an implausible outlier — a spoof. Also "pct": "0.18" doesn't match. Also headline "The trades in a narrow range ahead of the close" at 09:33 — odd (ahead of the close at 9:33 AM?), but that's mundane-ish. The main flag is the 386.12 quote far from surrounding quotes at the same timestamp.

Flag spoof.
